Actual salaries may be based on several factors including, but not limited to, a candidate's skill set, experience, education and other qualifications. Suffolk offers a comprehensive benefits package as part of its overall total rewards strategy. Salary ranges are reviewed regularly to reflect market trends.

About Suffolk

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment (Suffolk Technologies). By integrating data, artificial intelligence, and advanced technology through our Seamless Platform, we connect design, construction, and operations to deliver smarter, more predictable results and redefine how America builds.

Suffolk – America’s Contractor – is a national company with more than $9 billion in annual revenue, 3,000 employees, and 17 offices, including Boston (headquarters), New York City, Miami, West Palm Beach, Tampa, Estero, Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Las Vegas, Herndon, U.S. Virgin Islands, and other key markets. Suffolk manages some of the most complex and transformative projects in the country, serving clients across healthcare, life sciences, education, gaming, aviation, transportation, government, mission critical, and commercial sectors. Suffolk is privately held and is led by founder, chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked #8 on ENR’s list of “Top CM-at-Risk Contractors.” For more information, visit www.suffolk.com and follow Suffolk on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Instagram.

That’s why we have created a program that provides employees with access to a wide variety of options that can be personalized to support you and your loved ones physically, emotionally, and financially.

Benefits include, competitive salaries, auto allowances and gas cards for certain roles, access to market leading medical and emotional and mental health benefits, dental, and vision insurance plans, virtual care options for physical therapy and primary care, generous paid time off, 401k plan with employer match and access to expert financial resources, company paid and voluntary life insurance, tax deferred savings accounts, 10 backup daycare days each year, short- and long-term disability, commuter benefits and more.? title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
Overview

Millennium is proud to be part of the Markon enterprise, a network of specialized organizations united in support of critical national security missions. This partnership strengthens our ability to deliver results by expanding our technical depth, operational reach, and access to a broader bench of proven experts, ensuring our customers continue to receive best-in-class cybersecurity support.Since 2004, Millennium has operated at the forefront of cybersecurity. Our elite team of over 300 professionals brings an unmatched record of performance across Red Team Operations, Defensive Cyber Operations, Software Engineering, and Technical Engineering. As home to the largest contingent of contracted Red Team operators supporting the Department of Defense, Millennium delivers unparalleled threat intelligence and battle-tested expertise to both DoD and federal civilian customers.

What We Believe

Millennium is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Responsibilities

Millennium is seeking a REMOTE AWS DevOps Engineer to support the Naval Information Warfare Center Atlantic (NIWC Atlantic) Expeditionary Enterprise Systems and Services (E2S2) Division. NIWC Atlantic provides design, acquisition, and sustainment services for Marine Corps Systems Command (MCSC) Information Technology (IT) systems).

This is a mid level engineering position that focuses on the design, optimization, and sustainment of AWS cloud environments for the Marine Corps Systems Command (MCSC). The engineer will act as a bridge between technical infrastructure management and federal compliance, ensuring high performance, security, and availability within a fast-paced, government-contracted environment.

*An active Secret clearance is required for consideration*

The AWS DevOps Engineer will:

  • Engineer and maintain optimal performance and availability of customer AWS environments using IaC and automation.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex cloud infrastructure issues and provide support for technical hurdles related to cloud systems.
  • Work closely with IT stakeholders, developers, security analysts, and project managers to align infrastructure with business goals.
  • Lead automation initiatives and provide guidance/mentoring to junior engineering staff.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for architecture decisions, automation processes, and compliance artifacts.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret Security Clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (Degree must be ABET-accredited; degree from a regionally accredited institution)
  • 7 years of software or network engineering experience with 3+ years of consistent experience specifically in AWS Cloud Security, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
  • AWS security/networking: VPC, firewalls/NGFW, IDS/IPS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail.
  • DevSecOps/CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab, AWS CodePipeline; SAST/DAST/SCA.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Python, Bash, or Go automation.
  • Policy-as-code, security automation, and auto-remediation.
  • ECS/EKS and container security experience.

This position is remote but visits to customer site (Charleston, SC) will be required. Currently, customer site visits for Program Increment Planning occur four times per year, one week each.

Business Development

Assist with Business Development activities as required to support Millennium's strategic business objectives, which may include but not limited to participation in technical interviews, creation of technical documentation, general proposal writing support and proposal color reviews.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be comfortable with prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 10-15 pounds at a time.

COMPENSATION:

$145,000- $150,000

The salary range provided for this position is intended as a general guideline and does not guarantee a specific salary or compensation amount. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including, relevant education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.

title: Commercial Banking Director
description:
Overview

Old National Bank has been serving clients and communities since 1834. With over $70 billion in total assets, we are a regional powerhouse deeply rooted in the communities we serve. As a trusted partner, we thrive on helping our clients achieve their goals and dreams, and we are committed to social responsibility and investing in our communities through volunteering and charitable giving.

We continually seek highly motivated and talented individuals as our people are critical to our success. In return, we offer competitive compensation with our salary and incentive program, in addition to medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401K, continuing education opportunities and an employee assistance program are also included in our benefit suite. Old National also offers a variety of Impact Network Groups led by team members who are passionate about driving engagement, creating awareness of diverse backgrounds and experiences, and building inclusion across the organization. We offer a unique opportunity to join a growing, community and client-focused company that is firmly rooted in its core values.

Responsibilities

The Commercial Banking Director is responsible for generating new loan and deposit business, according to assigned sales goals, by initiating and developing relationships with businesses, industries, developers and consumers. This position maintains acceptable credit quality and appropriate loan pricing. Team portfolio management and client relationship expansion, including partner referrals, are critical for success in this position. This role leads the Middle market banking team in the Detroit, Michigan Metro Area Geography.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $127,900. - $258,600. The base salary indicated for this position reflects the compensation range applicable to all levels of the role across the United States. Actual salary offers within this range may vary based on a number of factors, including the specific responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s relevant skills and professional experience, educational qualifications, and geographic location.

Key Accountabilities

  • Spearhead the development and growth of Middle Market to execute relationships with clients and prospects focusing on revenue generation, retention, and identifying growth opportunities.
  • Communicates sales goals and expectations and manages performance of relationship managers.
  • Leads sales management efforts and activities including weekly sales meetings, business development calls, client relations and coaching of relationship managers.
  • Partners with Treasury Management and Merchant Services, Wealth, Swap, Community Banking and others to offer solutions that deepen client relationships.
  • Prospects businesses with focus on businesses with revenue sizes between $5MM - $50MM and credit exposure of $1MM - $10MM – along with deposit opportunities.
  • Works to achieve assigned team’s sales goals through proactive activities and behaviors that lead to results.
  • Aligns client and bank objectives and orchestrates organizational resources and referral partners to build collaborative, client-focused relationships.
  • Leverages centers of influence to build a network and create a pipeline of business.
  • Ensures that the team is managing a portfolio of customers satisfactorily, ensuring the relationships are maintained in a professional manner and monitoring of the portfolio meets current loan standards.
  • Strives to meet or exceed average portfolio target by strengthening existing client relationships and fostering new relationships.
  • Manages delinquencies and portfolio to ensure that classified credits are recognized timely and referred promptly to Special Assets.

Key Competencies for Position

Develops Talent - Maximizes capabilities within team.

  • Develops team members' effectiveness in their current and future roles through development activities.
  • Identifies issues, continuously provides coaching, mentoring, feedback and support to aid in building trust, development and promotability.
  • Cultivates an environment of trust and optimizes talents and capabilities of team.
  • Identifies the right people for the right role while leveraging diversity.

Strategy in Action – Fosters strategic capability in self and others.

  • Connects work to the broader goals (i.e., team, line of business) and communicates team member's role in contributing to Old National's strategy and goals.
  • Demonstrates awareness and understanding of environmental factors influencing their role.
  • Anticipates, identifies, and articulates potential issues and opportunities and effectively responds.
  • Identifies immediate, near-term opportunities required for business impact while exploring multiple viewpoints to generate and implement new ideas improving performance.
  • Inspires others to personally contribute to the organization’s success for the long term.

Makes Decisions & Solves Problems - Seeks deeper understanding, identifies alternative solutions, and drives sound decisions.

  • Identifies, evaluates, and owns problems and opportunities along with possible solutions through effective collaboration.
  • Collaborates and seeks to identify what caused the issue, comparing data from different sources within Old National to draw conclusions.
  • Uses effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions resulting in sound decisions.
  • Implements appropriate solutions and evaluates results within team.

Delights Clients - Consistently seeks and leverages knowledge creating a best-in-class experience for clients and team members.

  • Supports an environment for passionately serving internal/external clients with excellence.
  • Nurtures a growth mindset by staying current with developments and trends related to role and sharing information with team identifying potential client impact.
  • Understands data, metrics and/or financial information and how they tie to business outcomes related to client, team and business area.
  • Creates an environment of accountability where team nurtures client relationships by listening, prioritizing and acting responsibly to meet client needs, mitigate risk and add shareholder value.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or H.S. Diploma/GED with equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 10 years relevant Middle Market and/or other Commercial Banking experience.
  • Proven leadership experience, including prior management of relationship managers.
  • Ability to orchestrate organizational resources by identifying key players, communicating relevant information, and building collaborative client-focused relationships.
  • Possesses a thorough knowledge of Loan Standards, Loan Review Administration and Banking/OCC Procedures.
  • Very high level of written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must have a proven track record of successful sales performance with strong business development skills and portfolio management skills.
  • Very high level of sales, negotiation and financial analysis skills.
  • Position may require the need to travel to other Old National, client or meeting locations.

Old National is proud to be an equal opportunity employer focused on fostering an inclusive workplace and committed to hiring a workforce comprised of diverse backgrounds, cultures and thinking styles.

As such, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

We do not accept resumes from external staffing agencies or independent recruiters for any of our openings unless we have an agreement signed by the Director of Talent Acquisition, SVP to fill a specific position.

Our culture is firmly rooted in our core values.

We are optimistic. We are collaborative. We are inclusive. We are agile. We are ethical.

We are Old National Bank.

Join our team!

title: Newborn Hearing Screen Technician - Part Time
description:
Overview

Join us in making a difference in the early detection of hearing loss in newborns as a Newborn Hearing Screen Technician! As a newborn hearing screen technician, you will provide hearing screens in the hospital after a baby is born. You will work on-site at one or more hospital locations to screen newborns for hearing loss. At Pediatrix, you will receive on-the-job training. This includes annual certification accredited by the American Academy of Audiology. By offering this certification, we strive to ensure our employees are adept in improving early detection of hearing impairments and encouraging timely intervention. Central Virginia Baptist Hospital

Responsibilities

The Hearing Screen Technician (HST) performs hearing screens and provides education to parents on the relevance of hearing screens and the importance of early intervention.

  • Comply with all company and facility policies and procedures including, but not limited to, appropriate PPE, required vaccinations and other safety/security protocols, Company and Hospital Orientations and annual compliance modules; Raise any questions or concerns from hospital staff and/or leadership as appropriate to HS Manager.
  • Evaluate each patient for “screen readiness” prior to performing a screen; the technician will only screen patients that are in the appropriate state to achieve a reliable result (fed, quiet, not moving/agitated, calm)
  • Collect all necessary data/demographics for each baby. Perform the hearing screen and all screen-related services on all eligible babies during each shift. Ensure documentation protocol is followed for every screen.
  • Treat each screened baby (and his/her family) with the care and consideration required at this important development milestone.
  • Upload all screen results/billing/state reporting by the end of each shift and ensure the stats for each screen are complete and reconciled, unless otherwise instructed by Site Supervisor.
  • Perform all screens in an efficient manner and follow the appropriate process to minimize time in the patient room, without sacrificing quality or patient education / satisfaction.
  • Ensure all relevant information is provided to the party responsible for each screened baby, and the parent/guardian receives appropriate education about the necessity of the screen, and what to do with the results.
  • Notify Site Supervisor of all missed and final refer babies.
  • Schedule Outpatient appointment for refer babies, where appropriate. Other duties as assigned.

.

  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.

title: ERP Application Developer
description:
Overview

​​​​The ERP Application Developer develops, extends, automates, and supports applications within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM and Power Platform ecosystem. The role will work closely with the ERP Technical & Integration Lead, business teams, and implementation partners to build sustainable solutions and reduce long-term reliance on external consultants. This role is well suited for an early-career professional with strong technical aptitude, curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn and grow into deeper D365 application ownership. This position is expected to collaborate across IT, business teams, implementation partners, and other stakeholders. Occasional after-hours and weekend work may be required to support planned system releases, cutovers, maintenance activities, and critical production incidents.​​​

Responsibilities

  • ​​Develop and maintain D365 F&SCM X++ extensions, including data entities, custom fields, report data providers, and business logic
  • ​Build and maintain REST APIs, OData services, and application connectors
  • ​Develop Power Apps for manufacturing, warehouse, and business-process use cases, including shop floor forms, production reporting, maintenance requests, and OTTO AMR exception logging
  • ​Develop Power Automate workflows for approvals, notifications, exception handling, and process automation
  • ​Design and maintain Dataverse tables, relationships, and application data structures
  • ​Create and maintain governed D365 data entities, APIs, and OData endpoints for integration and analytics consumption
  • ​Partner with the Data Analytics Engineer to expose clean D365 data entities and OData feeds for reporting and analytics consumption.
  • ​Develop reusable application components and automation solutions in accordance with technical architecture standards
  • ​Perform debugging, root-cause analysis, and application defect resolution
  • ​Create unit tests and support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release validation
  • ​Validate customizations and integrations against Microsoft D365 platform update
  • ​Participate in code reviews, source-control practices, Azure DevOps, LCS (Lifecycle Services) package management, and release processes
  • ​Support the ERP Technical and Integration Lead on X++ extension deployments, code reviews, and D365 release validation activities
  • ​Maintain application design, development, and support documentation
  • ​Work with business users to understand requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • ​Support post-go-live enhancements, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement
  • ​Provide occasional after-hours and weekend support during planned releases, cutovers, system maintenance, and critical production incidents​

Essential Functions

  • Must be highly motivated, able to follow direction, and perform assigned work duties independently with minimal supervision
  • ​​Ability to manage multiple projects
  • ​​Must be able to effectively analyze and present complex information
  • ​​Must be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing
  • ​​Must have aptitude for problem solving
  • ​​Must be able to speak, listen, and effectively collaborate and communicate with team members
  • ​​Must be able to work with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • ​​Must have full use of arms and legs and be able to climb stairs to access all areas of the plant and offices
  • ​​Able to kneel, squat, bend, stoop, twist, and lift >20lbs. on an occasional basis
  • ​​Must be organized and maintain work area
  • ​​Ability to work under the pressure of, and meet, deadlines
  • ​​Able to travel to other Joy Baking Group sites​
  • ​Ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
  • ​Ability to coordinate with business stakeholders, external vendors, and systems integrators
  • ​Ability to troubleshoot complex system, integration, and data issues across multiple platforms
  • ​Ability to support after-hours ERP deployment, cutover, and production support activities as needed
  • ​Ability to document technical processes, standards, and system architecture clearly
  • ​Ability to evaluate technical solutions with long-term scalability, maintainability, and operational supportability in mind

Qualifications

  • ​​​Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field (recent graduates are encouraged to apply)
  • ​1-3 years of application development experience (internship, academic project, or portfolio experience may be considered)
  • ​Foundational programming skills in one or more languages such as C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar
  • ​Basic SQL and relational database knowledge
  • ​Familiarity with APIs, JSON, REST, web services, or application integration concepts
  • ​Microsoft certifications or demonstrated self-directed learning in the Microsoft technology stack
  • ​Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&SCM and/or X++ is preferred
  • ​Exposure to Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, or Azure is preferred
  • ​Experience with REST APIs, OData, OAuth, or application integration is preferred
  • ​Azure DevOps, Git, LCS (Lifecycle Services), or other source-control and ALM tooling experience is preferred
  • ​Manufacturing, warehouse, ERP, or business application exposure is preferred

title: UNAVAILABLE
description:
Overview

As a patient-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of people through patient care, research and education. Success in this mission requires a culture of collaboration, excellence, leadership, and respect. University of Utah Health seeks staff that are committed to the values of compassion, collaboration, innovation, responsibility, integrity, quality and trust that are integral to our mission. EO/AA

Clinical pharmacists implement medication therapy for patients and monitor care, insuring safe, effective, and cost-efficient treatment. This includes the preparation of medications, participating in the drug distribution process, monitoring drug therapy, providing drug information to patients and providers, providing clinical pharmacy services, solving medication related problems for individual patients as well as in the medication use process. Clinical pharmacists must work effectively as a team member, communicate clearly, assertively, and professionally, to all pharmacy patients, their families, and staff members, providing superior customer service when interacting with patients, visitors, family members, staff, co-workers, and vendors. Clinical pharmacists must be willing to work with trainees in the department (eg, students, interns, residents or new staff).

Corporate Overview: The University of Utah is a Level 1 Trauma Center and is nationally ranked and recognized for our academic research, quality standards and overall patient experience. Our five hospitals and eleven clinics provide excellence in our comprehensive services, medical advancement, and overall patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for the medication use process of preparing and dispensing medications following medication use policy and all laws, regulations, and standards applicable to pharmacy practice. Solves problems in the medication use process for patients and the organization.
  • Assesses appropriate drug information and literature resources, and provides effective information to varied audiences including patients, other health care professions, and peers.
  • Identifies and engages in organizational and department quality improvement activities to improve patient care, medication use process, and pharmacy operations.
  • May supervise daily workflow to accomplish daily tasks allotted to the pharmacist and those who report to him or her (e.g., technicians, residents, students, or interns
  • Educates and trains residents, students, interns, colleagues and other health care professionals as well as supervises technicians, residents, interns, or trainees in their job tasks.
  • May perform the responsibilities of a pharmacist-in-charge, or license holder according to Federal, State of Utah, or other relevant states, or laws and regulations. This includes meeting all of the regulatory and compliance issues for the assigned registered pharmacy.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.
  • Ability and willingness to train department trainees (eg students, residents, new staff).
  • Ability to assess data regarding the patient's status and provide care as described in the department's policies and procedures manual.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served on his or her assigned unit.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the principles of life span growth and development and the ability to assess data regarding the patient's status and provide care as described in the department's policies and procedures manual.

Qualifications

Required

  • Advanced degree (PharmD or MS) or equivalent clinical practice experience.
  • Demonstrated effective communication and computer literacy skills.
  • Additional qualifications may be required depending on area the pharmacist is primarily assigned to work. Examples of additional qualifications could include basic or advanced life-support training, residency training, or certifications.

Licenses Required

  • Current licensure to dispense controlled substances in the State of Utah.
  • One of the following
    • Current time-limited license to practice as a Pharmacist in the State of Utah. The time-limited license is issued in cases of State Emergencies and are valid only during the time frame indicated.
    • Current Pharmacist license in the State of Utah.
* Additional license requirements as determined by the hiring department.

Qualifications (Preferred)

Preferred

  • Residency training.

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without an accommodation.

  • This position involves light work that may exert up to 20 pounds and may consistently require light work involving lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling or otherwise moving objects. This position involves standing for extended periods of time and is not exposed to adverse environmental conditions.

Physical Requirements

Carrying, Color Determination, Lifting, Listening, Manual Dexterity, Near Vision, Pulling and/or Pushing, Reaching, Sitting, Speaking, Standing, Stooping and Crouching, Walking

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Overview

For more than 30 years, PowerPlan has helped North American energy companies make the right financial decisions which improve lives and powers the world. Through our industry-leading expertise, innovative technology and vast experience listening to and working in tandem with our customers, PowerPlan software sets the standard that CFOs can count on.

PowerPlan is looking for a hands-on, solutions-oriented DevOps Engineer to lead the design, automation, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure in support of our SaaS products. This role is essential in ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient software delivery across Azure and multi-cloud environments. The ideal candidate combines deep technical skills in automation, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, and observability with a proactive, collaborative mindset.

This position works closely with development, security, and operations teams to drive continuous improvement in our DevOps practices and ensure high availability and performance for both internal development teams and external customers.

Responsibilities

Key Performance Objectives

  • CI/CD Automation and Optimization: Within 90 days, evaluate and document current CI/CD processes; by 6 months, identify all differences between current Dev and Cloud pipelines and develop plan for joining the two. Implement automated testing and rollback strategies across multiple environments (dev/test/stage/prod).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Deployment: Provision and manage cloud infrastructure in Azure (and AWS if applicable) using Terraform within the first 60 days. Deploy at least two major environments (including networking, security, and compute resources) following standardized IaC modules.
  • Support and Troubleshoot Production Environments: Triage and resolve 90%+ of DevOps-related support tickets within defined SLAs. Provide on-call support in a rotating schedule, maintaining service availability and rapid incident resolution with minimal escalations.
  • Improve System Observability: Within 3 months, implement log aggregation and metrics visualization dashboards (e.g., using Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor). Identify key gaps in alerts/dashboards within Coralogix platform and develop plan to implement by 6 months.
  • Access and Security Enhancements: Configure identity federation using SAML/OIDC and manage Windows AD or Entra ID domains securely by month 3. By month 6, coordinate with customers to configure SAML integration for 3 different environments.
  • Container Orchestration and Deployment: By the end of the second quarter, deploy at least one new containerized application using Kubernetes and Helm, and document the process for reuse across teams. Ensure all containers follow secure configuration practices and are integrated with monitoring and alerting systems.
  • DevOps Process Leadership: Partner with 3+ development Scrum teams to streamline DevOps collaboration, establishing best practices for branching, code reviews, and release cycles. Serve as primary DevOps point-of-contact for new project launches and tech stack updates.
  • Cost Efficiency in Cloud Operations: By 6 months, review cloud spend strategy and identify 2 alerts or automations to reduce monthly cost by customer.

Qualifications

Certifications

  • Essential: Fundamentals: AZ-900
  • Preferred: Administrator: AZ-104, DevOps: AZ-400

Essential Skills:

  • 3-5 Years CloudOps and/or DevOps experience supporting PaaS/SaaS environments.
  • Understanding of system and network architecture, system platforms, system access, and network protocols.
  • Experience using various tools for application and infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and possess high level of technical skills, analytical, problem solving, verbal, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with Agile methodology and running or participating in Scrum/Kanban procedures.
  • Proficient in Azure Cloud services – Data Factory, AKS, Key Vault, App Services, Storage Accounts
  • Experience in using Terraform for infrastructure as code and automation.
  • Skilled in PowerShell for scripting and task automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration and support.
  • Expertise in YAML and Helm for configuration management and deployment automation.
  • Strong documentation skills for maintaining clear and comprehensive technical records.
  • Proficiency in Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines and project management.
  • Knowledge of Docker for containerization and application deployment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with API management for seamless integration and performance optimization.
  • Expertise with configuring identify federation (SAML, OIDC, Okta)
  • Understanding of Firewall, Encryption, IDS/IPS, AV (anti-virus) tools.
  • Hands-on experience with Configuration Management (Puppet, Chef, & Ansible).
  • Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring, APM, Log aggregation tools.
  • Experience with MLOps – model governance, deployment, security, monitoring
  • Expertise in SQL for database management and data warehouse solutions (Databricks, Snowflake)

Core Competencies & Attributes

  • Technical Mastery: Skilled in Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Git, scripting (PowerShell, Python), and CI/CD toolchains.
  • Reliability Engineering: Strong focus on system uptime, alerting, redundancy, and recovery.
  • Automation-First Mindset: Seeks opportunities to reduce manual effort through scripting, orchestration, and tooling.
  • Security-Driven: Integrates security practices in all stages of development and deployment.
  • Customer Focus: Responsive to internal and external stakeholders, especially during urgent requests or incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works seamlessly with developers, security engineers, and IT to ensure smooth releases and environment stability.
  • Process Improvement: Constantly evaluates and improves DevOps workflows, infrastructure, and deployment practices.

PowerPlan is an EOE

Applicant Privacy Notice

Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

Completes event reports as needed.

title: Leading Engineering Developer - Enterprise AI Products - Senior Vice President - Citi
description:
Discover your future at Citi
Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview
About the Team
The Enterprise AI Products team is a small, high-impact global team within the Citi COO/CTO organisation, dedicated to building innovative solutions for the wider bank.
We are at the forefront of Agentic AI, delivering capabilities that enable data sharing across agent ecosystems, supporting Agentic use cases, and shaping modern Agentic architecture through purpose-built tooling. Our work sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real-world business impact.

The Role
We are looking for a seasoned Lead Engineering Developer to join our team. This person will perform a role of working with the business on how to use our tools, understanding real business problems in detail to dive changes to our platform and support the business in successful commercial deployments of the tools that we provide. They will have architect and development responsibilities across our AI enabled platform.
This is a senior role within a deliberately flat team structure. You will be expected to take ownership, bring fresh thinking, and collaborate closely with colleagues across disciplines. Equally important is your ability to engage directly with business partners - understanding their problems, translating them into technical solutions, and delivering outcomes that genuinely make a difference.
You will help set the strategy for the platform with our team lead and balance technical changes with support business deliverables.
You will gain meaningful exposure to AI development and solutions, alongside a broad range of technical work in a fast-moving, delivery-focused environment.

Responsibilities
Technical Leadership

  • Own, lead, and manage technical components end-to-end, ensuring alignment with business objectives and the wider product strategy.
  • Function lead team members in technical deliverables, Although this role does not have line management initially, the role may evolve to have formal line management.
  • Understand where AI should be used, should not be used and how to use it given business need. This will cover Agents, GenAI and other AI capabilities.
  • Articulate and justify decisions and plans made with department and stakeholder MD/Ds
  • Work with partners in Risk and other AI platform teams to help evolve Citi technology and procedures.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to shape a compelling vision and technical roadmap for our products.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, elevating the team's overall capability.
  • Ensure software quality through rigorous code reviews, technical design reviews, and a strong testing culture (unit and integration testing).
Business Engagement
  • Engage directly with business partners to understand real business problems in detail - this role goes well beyond engineering.
  • Must be able to talk and partner with the business and other technology teams on their own. The role requires creating and agreeing roadmaps that technology can deliver to while also allowing the business to meet their commercial goals
  • Work with stakeholders to capture objectives and outcomes and distil into requirements, identify pain points, and translate them into actionable user stories and a prioritised backlog.
  • Work with the business on timelines, ensure any agreements made can be delivered by the team and are balanced against current commitments.
  • Work with clients to deliver outcomes, gather feedback, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Work with internal clients (business and technology) to understand and help them using our tools
  • Spot opportunities to deliver value and proactively bring them to the team.
Engineering & Delivery
  • Design, develop, and implement robust solutions using object-oriented programming and sound technical design principles.
  • Write production-quality code in Python or Java - both languages are actively used in this role.
  • Working with ML flow.
  • Designing developing and testing agent build in Google ADK
  • Working with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and creating servers.
  • Other technology we use includes Neo4j, Postgres, Kafka and libraries such as FAST API.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable, repeatable deployments.
  • Collaborate with teammates on shared components and codebases.
  • Apply knowledge of networking, REST APIs, databases, and CLI tooling in day-to-day delivery.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues swiftly and effectively.
Risk & Compliance
  • Take ownership of risk and security considerations, ensuring solutions meet Citi's policies - and setting an example by going above and beyond where it matters.
Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Work alongside other teams to ensure technology integrates seamlessly with the broader platform and solution landscape.
  • Our deliverables are platform capabilities that must integrate with other systems in teams beyond our own, building trust and organizational partnerships is key.
What We're Looking For
Essential
  • Proven experience as a senior developer, technical lead, or similar role.
  • Strong background in object-oriented programming, technical design, and architecture.
  • Proficiency in at least one of: Java orPython- with hands-on experience in both Python and Java preferred. Postgres/Oracle experience.
  • Experience with Generative AI, some knowledge of AI Agents specifically ADK.
  • Practical experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g. Jenkins, uDeploy, Tekton, Harness, or equivalent).
  • Demonstrable experience driving technical strategy and roadmaps, with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence senior (MD-level) stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to troubleshoot under pressure.
  • Solid foundational knowledge of networking concepts, REST APIs, databases, and CLI.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to engage at all levels.
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve.
  • Line management and team leadership experience.

JOB SUMMARY

Inspects and monitors environmental health and safety concerns. Directs the enforcement of health laws and regulations. Supervises and manages staff, and acts as a representative and spokesperson for the Bureau. This position resides in the Water Quality & Hazardous Waste Bureau and supervises the Onsite Wastewater, Watershed, Drinking Water and Stormwater Response programs. These programs promote and protect our watersheds and drinking water sources, regulate wastewater disposal and investigate and enforce on illicit discharges and chemical spills in storm drains and waterways.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Environmental Health or a related area of study as required for Environmental Health Scientist licensure, current Licensure in the State of Utah as an Environmental Health Scientist, or must be eligible for license reciprocity as determined by the Utah Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing, or must obtain licensure within sixty (60) days from the date of hire.

Must have three (3) years of experience working in Public or Environmental Health.

Preference will be given to applicants with prior supervisory experience.

A valid Driver’s License accepted by the State of Utah is required at the time of hire. A valid Driver’s License issued by the State of Utah must be obtained within six (6) months of hire to operate a County vehicle.

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant must pass a required background check through fingerprinting and enrollment in the continuous RAP Back (Record of Arrest and Prosecution Back) program in accordance with current County Human Resources policy requirements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Manages programs by coordinating and implementing objectives.
  • Supervises staff, which includes recommendations on hiring, orienting, training, assigning and reviewing work performance, annual work performance appraisals, and discipline.
  • Manages the enforcement of health regulations related to assigned program areas.
  • Conducts inspections, audits, tests, and surveys to determine compliance with health laws, regulations, and standards. Evaluates and records conditions found and takes appropriate corrective action.
  • Collects delinquent fees and issues closure and suspension notices for failure of compliance. Conducts dispute resolution.
  • Communicates environmental health information and distributes education materials and other informational resources to the public.
  • Acts as coach and mentor, trains, or determines and ensures the proper training of Bureau staff. Attends and participates in seminars, on-the-job training, and other required educational activities.
  • Plans and conducts studies, and prepares reviews and approves reports, presentations, and materials.
  • Reviews applications, license referrals, permit applications, and other documents to determine compliance with health laws and regulations and recommends revisions and approval or denial.
  • Prepares and issues notices and orders, prepares court complaints, follows through with legal counsel and courts, and testifies as an expert witness in court and administrative hearings.
  • Collects samples and conducts tests following established quality assurance and quality control procedures.
  • Coordinates with local, State, and Federal entities.
  • Participates in and helps manage local,/community public and environmental health events and programs.
  • Assists in drafting and enacting County regulations and policies in compliance with State and Federal laws.
  • Assists in managing budget and reviews budgetary documents for accuracy.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSA)

Knowledge of:

  • Public and environmental health
  • Program area sampling, testing, and laboratory procedures
  • Governmental and community organizations
  • Federal, State, local, and health department laws related to environmental health
  • Report writing and preparation
  • Research and statistical methods, data collection and analysis, data entry and retrieval
  • Effective public relations and health education methods and techniques
  • Effective supervision and program management
  • Hazardous and solid waste management

Skills and Abilities to:

  • Communicate and express self clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing
  • Work effectively with people from a variety of social, ethnic, economic, educational, and professional backgrounds
  • Work with minimum supervision and act independently when appropriate
  • Effectively supervise, train, and motivate others; effect change in ideas and attitudes
  • Plan and conduct research
  • Design, organize, coordinate, and develop programs and policies
  • Prepare material for media and community dissemination
  • Operate a personal computer, sampling and testing equipment, and other program-related equipment
  • Respond adequately to problems and utilize problem-solving techniques
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with public, government, and private groups and individuals
  • Assess risk and assign appropriate fee structures for noncompliance
  • Deal tactfully with upset and angry individuals in matters of enforcement, compliance, and dispute resolution

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Considerable walking over rough terrain and going to difficult-to-access places; bending and kneeling. May be required to carry bulky equipment necessary for the performance of various duties.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION REGARDING THIS POSITION

This position works Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with occasional events on weekends, holidays and afterhours

title: Senior Software Engineer

description:
About The Position

We invite applications for a position as Senior Software Engineer - Data Science, Climate and Health, available at the HISP Centre.

About The Position

We invite applications for a position as Senior Software Engineer - Data Science, Climate and Health, available at the HISP Centre.

The position is permanent subject to availability of external funding. Starting date no later than October 1st, 2026.

Place of work is the HISP Centre at Department of Informatics, Oslo.

Job Description

The HISP Centre is looking for a senior software engineer to strengthen the data science side of its climate and health project. The project develops Chap, an open-source platform that connects climate data to disease forecasting inside DHIS2, enabling countries to run, evaluate, and own their own predictive models for climate-sensitive diseases such as malaria, dengue and cholera. Chap is developed in close collaboration with ministries of health and national HISP partners across 17 countries in sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia, together with the global HISP network. The project is funded by Wellcome Trust.

The position sits at the intersection of software engineering and applied data science. You will work on the modelling and evaluation side of the platform - the components that let external forecasting models be plugged in, run inside a country’s own infrastructure, and be compared under identical, platform-governed evaluation criteria. This includes contributing to the model template architecture, the evaluation and back testing framework, and the pipelines that turn climate, environmental and health surveillance data into forecasts delivered back into DHIS2 dashboards. There are also ambitions to move the analytical methodology towards causal decision support questions, like estimating effects of disease interventions or early warning systems as such.

Because Chap is built as much through participatory action research as through software engineering, the role also has a project-facing dimension: translating feedback from country teams and domain experts into concrete technical requirements and helping shape how the platform evolves as it scales to more countries and use cases.

Qualification Requirements

In this role you must have:

title: Principal, NYBC Ventures
description:
Responsibilities

New York Blood Center Enterprises (NYBCe) is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Principal to join NYBC Ventures, the organization's specialty life sciences venture fund. This is an opportunity for a senior life sciences investor to take on significant deal ownership and portfolio leadership within one of the world's leading blood and biotherapeutics organizations, with direct exposure to a differentiated portfolio spanning hematology, cell therapy, biologics, and adjacent fields.

The role is based in Boston, MA and is an in-office position. It reports directly to the Managing Director of NYBC Ventures & SVP of Ventures and Business Development. The Principal operates with autonomy and is expected to lead investments and portfolio relationships directly, while contributing to fund strategy under the Managing Director.

Investment Diligence & Sourcing

  • Lead the full investment lifecycle — sourcing, scientific and commercial diligence, structuring, and closing — across NYBC Ventures' portfolio and new deal pipeline.
  • Conduct and oversee in-depth competitive landscape analysis, market sizing, and IP assessment for prospective investments.
  • Co-author investment memos and support recommendations to the Investment Committee.
  • Originate and maintain relationships with co-investors, entrepreneurs, academic founders, and ecosystem partners in the blood, biologics, and broader life sciences space.

Portfolio Management & Support

  • Serve directly in board or observer roles for a portfolio of active investments, with full ownership of milestone tracking and financial reporting review.
  • Lead preparation for board and observer meetings; take primary responsibility for a defined segment of active board coverage.
  • Lead follow-on financing tracking and support capital raise processes for portfolio companies.
  • Contribute directly to communications, portfolio updates, and fund reporting, including Board materials.

Fund Operations & Strategy

  • Drive NYBC Ventures' strategic initiatives, including thesis development, market landscape assessments, and sector-specific investment frameworks.
  • Lead deal structuring, cap table analysis, and financial modeling for new investments and follow-ons.
  • Own fund administration workstreams including exit analysis, waterfall modeling, and distribution planning.
  • Support the Managing Director on emerging fund strategy and team development.

Level Expectations:

  • Diligence: Leads diligence independently across scientific, clinical, and commercial workstreams; owns investment thesis development and drives the IC memo end to end.
  • Deal Execution: Leads structuring and negotiation; owns full deal execution from term sheet through close, with minimal oversight.
  • Portfolio Management: Holds board or observer seats directly; manages portfolio company relationships and escalations with full independence.
  • Financial Modeling: Owns complex models, including waterfall, scenario, and follow-on analysis.
  • Sourcing: Proactively sources and originates deals; maintains a network of founders, co-investors, and ecosystem partners.
  • Communication: Produces polished memos and materials with no review required.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience:

  • 7 years in life sciences venture capital, growth equity, or investment banking, or related fields including a demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing investments.

Skills:

  • Cultural competency and the ability to communicate effectively in a culturally sensitive manner with both individuals and groups from diverse backgrounds.

Any combination of education, training and experience equivalent to the requirements above that has supplied the necessary knowledge, skills, and experience to perform the essential functions of the job.

Overview

Founded in 1964, New York Blood Center Enterprises (NYBCe) has provided more than 60 years of lifesaving research, innovation, and impact. NYBCe is one of the largest nonprofit blood centers, operating in 16 states and serving 75 million people. NYBCe operates Blood Bank of Delmarva, Community Blood Center of Kansas City, Connecticut Blood Center, Memorial Blood Centers, Nebraska Community Blood Bank, New Jersey Blood Services, New York Blood Center, and Rhode Island Blood Center, delivering one million blood products to 400+ U.S. hospitals annually. NYBCe additionally delivers cellular therapies, specialty pharmacy, and medical services to 200+ research, academic, and biopharmaceutical organizations. NYBCe’s Lindsley F. Kimball Research Institute is a leader in hematology and transfusion medicine research, dedicated to the study, prevention, treatment and cure of bloodborne and blood-related diseases. NYBCe is a vital community lifeline dedicated to helping patients and advancing global public health. To learn more, visit nybce.org. Connect with us on Facebook, X, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

description:
What You'll Do

This People Analytics Data Scientist is a senior role that will lead the development of advanced analytics and data science solutions, applying statistical modeling, experimentation, and predictive methods to shape Avalara's workforce strategy at scale. You'll translate complex people questions into robust analyses using tools such as R, Python, SQL, and modern analytics platforms. You'll partner with senior People, Finance, and business leaders to drive executive decision-making. What differentiates this role at Avalara is true end-to-end ownership—from data foundations and methodology through insight delivery and adoption—within a global SaaS environment that values rigorous, evidence-based approaches. This role reports to the VP, People Partners and Head of People Analytics. This is a remote position in the United States.

#LI-Remote

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience building, validating, and iterating on statistical or ML models using large, complex datasets.

  • 5+ years of experience applying rigorous analytical methods (e.g., experimental design, quasi-experimental approaches, predictive modeling) to inform business or people-related decisions.

  • Experience delivering multiple high-impact analytical outputs in parallel, balancing speed, accuracy, and stakeholder needs.

  • Experience communicating complex analytical findings to senior, non-technical stakeholders and influencing decisions with data.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a quantitative field such as statistics, economics, data science, computer science, or equivalent practical experience.

description:
Overview

H&M West is part of the MasTec Power Delivery segment. We are certified as a minority-controlled company by the National Minority Suppliers Development Council (NMSDC). Our rich diversity of people and ideas makes us a stronger, more innovative organization.

Position Summary:

The Estimator II prepares timely and accurate bid estimates for medium to large sized projects/programs within an assigned line of business, Region or Division and helps plan all projects with expectations for the efficient use of personnel, equipment, materials and subcontractors within contract requirements, time guidelines and other restrictions. The Estimator II will fully understand the major business components and implications specific to estimating and cost control for Construction Companies while ensuring compliance with the Henkels & McCoy established Project Management Methodology and upholding H&M safety and quality management protocols.

This is a remote position that will require travel to the Pacific Northwest (Portland, OR, Vancouver, WA) based on business needs, team meetings, customer engagements, and other key events.

Preference will be given to candidates located in the Western United States, including California, Nevada, Arizona, Washington, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Montana to support collaboration and travel requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare, develop, and maintain detailed cost estimates and bid documentation for Transmission & Distribution (T&D) and substation projects supporting BPA Master Service Agreement (MSA) scopes.
  • Review drawings, specifications, contracts, and customer requirements to develop accurate and competitive project estimates.
  • Travel to project sites to evaluate existing conditions, validate constructability, and support estimate accuracy.
  • Lead bid strategy discussions and support proposal development, pricing reviews, and customer presentations.
  • Coordinate with project management, engineering, procurement, and field operations teams during estimate development and project execution.
  • Monitor awarded contracts for scope changes, extra work authorizations, material impacts, credits, and other cost-related items.
  • Assist field personnel in identifying, developing, and recommending change orders and scope modifications as needed.
  • Ensure all bid submissions, customer deliverables, and presentation requirements are completed accurately and within established deadlines.
  • Identify potential construction risks, schedule impacts, and operational challenges, while recommending cost-effective solutions to minimize risk and improve project execution.
  • Support procurement planning by coordinating material pricing, vendor quotations, and subcontractor scopes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of estimating methodologies, tools, processes, and reporting aligned with H&M Project Management practices.
  • Interface with internal and external stakeholders regarding planning, scheduling, reporting requirements, progress updates, and project coordination activities.
  • Prepare and present estimate summaries, project assumptions, risk assessments, and pricing recommendations to leadership and clients.
  • Maintain effective communication with clients, project teams, and leadership while demonstrating professionalism and influencing project outcomes through collaboration and technical expertise.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant estimating experience in utility, electrical, transmission & distribution, substation, or heavy civil construction projects.
  • Demonstrated experience estimating mid-sized utility infrastructure projects, with strong knowledge of Transmission & Distribution (T&D), substation construction, and utility industry practices.
  • Proficiency with computerized estimating and bidding software (i.e. B2W, as well as advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Working knowledge of project management principles and practices, including completion of H&M Project Management Methodology (PMM) training and/or formal project management coursework.
  • Strong analytical and complex problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate project risks, interpret technical documentation, and develop practical, cost-effective solutions.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate across operations, engineering, procurement, and client teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple estimates, deadlines, and priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy in cost development, documentation, and reporting.

This is a remote position that will require travel to the Pacific Northwest (Portland, OR, Vancouver, WA) based on business needs, team meetings, customer engagements, and other key events.

Preference will be given to candidates located in the Western United States, including California, Nevada, Arizona, Washington, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Montana to support collaboration and travel requirements.

Salary Range: $79,700 - $119,500/annually

Benefits:

  • 401(k) Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Paid time off

title: Principal Power System Engineer
description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is looking to recruit a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer with a background in Generation and Load Interconnection, and Transmission Planning for the Western Interconnection region (WECC). In this role you will work closely with senior leadership to support our growth strategy and provide subject matter expertise both internally through coaching and developing staff as well as externally to our clients.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Perform and lead complex interconnection studies including load flow, short circuit and transient stability across multiple ISOs and Utilities in the Western Electricity Coordinating Council (WECC) footprint.
  • Review ISO and/or Utility interconnection study results, replicate findings and identify errors or alternative mitigations that could impact assigned network upgrades.
  • Support generation, large load and merchant transmission developers navigate interconnection processes across the Western Interconnected System (WECC).
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on interconnection related studies and stay up to date with industry trends and regulatory changes.
  • Support business development activities within ERCOT and/or the West.
  • Passionate about solving difficult technical problems, providing innovative solutions and taking ownership of the solutions provided.
  • Develop net new and enhance existing relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, industry organizations, and regulatory agencies.
  • Support the development of new products and services

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in the electric energy industry.
  • Experience in IBR modelling, transmission planning and/or interconnection studies.
  • Strong understanding of FERC, NERC and ISO interconnection requirements and standards.
  • In-depth knowledge of at least one but preferably several of the following software packages:PSLF, PowerWorld, PSSE, PSCAD, TARA and ASPEN
  • Experience in managing and mentoring technical teams.
  • Active participation in industry taskforces and/or working groups.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

How we support you:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • MyShare Employee Ownership Program
  • Work with industry leaders
  • 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

Location: This position is open to remote

Travel: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

EPE is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. The EEO is the Law poster, and its supplement are available using the following links: EEOC is the Law Poster

Third-Party Recruiting Notification

EPE does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited third-party resumes forwarded by recruiters to EPE via our career page or to any of our managers or employees will be considered public information, may be treated as a direct application from the person identified in the resume, and will not be eligible for placement fee payment to the agency. EPE will not pay a fee to a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed third-party agreement and has not coordinated their recruiting activity with the appropriate member of the Talent Acquisition team.

About i3

i3 is a technically diverse, 100% team member owned business, headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama specializing in missile and aviation systems engineering and logistic services, electronic warfare and electromagnetic effects analysis, UAS system integration and flight operations, full lifecycle C5ISR engineering services, cybersecurity and IT/IA innovative solutions and virtual training, simulation & serious game development and implementation. Perks of being a team member owner include:

Other outstanding benefits:

We work hard. We compete hard. We play hard. Apply now to join us!

About Us

A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in.

Job Description:

Hitachi Rail is looking for an enthusiastic self-motivated Senior Telecoms RAN Engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate is comfortable performing a wide range of tasks from administrative to strategic. The position is based in Brisbane, Australia.

The Senior Telecoms RAN Engineer will be primarily responsible for the testing, integration, commissioning, and optimisation of Radio Access Networks (RAN) across a range of rail telecommunications projects.

This role will ensure that all testing and integration activities are carried out in accordance with approved engineering documentation, project quality requirements, and site-specific safety and access requirements. The successful candidate will also support broader telecommunications system delivery through effective coordination of materials, field activities, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders.

This position will have a strong focus on field delivery, testing, and technical assurance of radio systems within operational and brownfield rail environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, configure, test, and optimise Radio Access Networks (RAN) to ensure high availability, performance, and reliability.

  • Integrate and configure BTS / radio equipment across GSM-R and related rail communications networks, including above-ground and tunnel environments.

  • Execute site testing, commissioning, and integration activities in accordance with approved procedures and project documentation.

  • Conduct drive testing, RF performance analysis, and produce detailed test reports and technical assessments.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve RAN-related issues during testing, integration, and commissioning phases.

  • Support broader telecommunications system integration and delivery activities, including coordination with signalling, ETCS, networking, power, and infrastructure interfaces where required.

  • Ensure all activities are completed in compliance with site safety, access, and rail corridor requirements.

  • Assist with planning and coordination of required materials, equipment, and site resources to support delivery activities.

  • Liaise with internal engineering teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and client stakeholders to ensure successful project outcomes.

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in RAN design, testing, integration, and commissioning, preferably on large-scale Australian infrastructure or rail projects.

  • Tertiary qualifications in Engineering or a related discipline, suitable for full membership with Engineers Australia.

  • Demonstrated experience in the design, integration, testing, and optimisation of GSM, GSM-R, LTE / 4G, and 5G radio technologies.

  • Strong understanding of RF principles, radio planning, coverage, interference, and performance analysis.

  • Hands-on experience with drive testing tools, RF analysis, and test reporting.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex RAN and telecoms integration issues in live or operational environments.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and site-based activities.

  • Well-developed communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, project delivery, subcontractor, and client teams.

  • Experience working in rail corridor, tunnel, or brownfield infrastructure environments will be highly regarded.

At Hitachi Rail, we know that a diverse business is a sustainable business. Working collaboratively with a range of internal networks, we’re continuously improving our policies and products. From accessible, sustainable design to achieving a better gender balance. We base these efforts on our core values: Harmony, Sincerity, and Pioneering spirit. And by aligning with these, we’re able to create a workplace where people not only feel comfortable but are given opportunities to thrive.

Ensures DevOps and Cloud engineering team technical compliance with design patterns and overall software standards.

Join ATI, a leader in Outpatient Physical Therapy, where you’ll be part of a team redefining musculoskeletal (MSK) care. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview

About PowerSchoolAt PowerSchool, we power education for students around the world. As the global leader in cloud-based K-12 software, we support the full education ecosystem—from the central office to the classroom to the home. Joining PowerSchool means being part of a mission-driven team that is transforming K-12 education by helping schools operate more effectively and deliver better outcomes for educators, students, and families.

Team Overview

Our Research & Development (R&D) team is the technical talent at the heart of our product suite, overseeing the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery. From engineering to quality assurance to data science, the R&D team ensures our customers seamlessly use our products and can depend on their consistency.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building and improving scalable, reliable, and high-quality software solutions that support our products and platform. You will apply strong software engineering fundamentals across the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization. In this role, you will work independently on complex features and systems, collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, and contribute to sound technical decisions within your team. You will also use generative AI, agentic AI, and other AI-enabled development tools to improve engineering efficiency, code quality, and delivery outcomes, while applying these tools responsibly and thoughtfully. This is a senior-level individual contributor role for an engineer who can solve a broad range of technical problems, contribute to system design, support engineering best practices, and mentor less experienced team members.

Responsibilities

Description

The Software Engineering team is a group of full stack developers who design, develop, and maintain our products, tools, and infrastructure.

Your day-to-day job will consist of:

    • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain software applications and services using modern programming languages such as TypeScript, Java, C#, Python, or other relevant technologies.
    • Own the delivery of complex features, services, or components with a high degree of independence, making sound technical decisions within established architectural patterns and team standards.
    • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate business and user needs into technical solutions, balancing functionality, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
    • Contribute to system and solution design, offering input on architecture, technical tradeoffs, and implementation approaches for new features and enhancements.
    • Use AI-assisted development tools for coding, debugging, documentation, testing, and analysis to improve productivity, code consistency, and development quality.
    • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards, quality expectations, and secure development practices.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, performance issues, and reliability concerns in both new and existing systems.
    • Contribute across all phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements and design through implementation, testing, release, and support.
    • Support quality assurance efforts by creating and maintaining unit tests, integration tests, and other validation approaches, including AI-augmented testing techniques where appropriate.
    • Apply current software design principles, patterns, algorithms, and data structures to build maintainable and efficient solutions.
    • Partner with team members to improve development workflows, automation, observability, and engineering efficiency.
    • Explore emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning capabilities, and recommend practical applications that improve the product, platform, or development process.
    • Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, code review feedback, and modeling strong engineering practices.
    • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, responsible AI usage, collaboration, and technical excellence.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5+ years of relevant and related work experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent, or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
  • Travel occasionally, up to 5-10%, for key moments such as team summits, training, conferences, etc., with increased frequency during peak periods based on business demands.
  • This position is subject to company on call policies which constitutes working hours outside of the normal workday as needed.
  • Additional experience may be substitute for an advanced Degree.
  • Proficiency in at least one or more programming languages such as TypeScript, Java, C#, Python, or other relevant tech stacks.
  • Experience delivering production-grade software and independently owning significant features or technical components.
  • Demonstrated ability to work on problems of diverse scope, analyze technical issues, and apply sound judgment to identify effective solutions.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (for example, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, or analysis) to improve productivity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI tools responsibly with consideration for security, privacy, reliability, maintainability, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Experience working within modern software development practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and Agile or Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, algorithms, and data structures.
  • Familiarity with SQL and database concepts; hands-on database experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with OWASP threats and mitigation techniques and secure coding practices.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment with limited day-to-day supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

PowerSchool offers the following benefits:

  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage (including Medical, Dental, Vision, Pharmacy benefits, Life Insurance and AD&D)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts and Health Savings Accounts
  • Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability
  • Comprehensive 401(k) plan
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • Unrestricted paid time off (known as Discretionary Time Off - DTO)
  • Wellness Program, including ClassPass & Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Optional Benefits: Pet Insurance, Identity Theft Protection, Student Debt Repayment Program and Prepaid Legal coverage

EEO Commitment

PowerSchool is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
